instruction: You are given an airfoil template `/home/user/Desktop/airfoil_base/`. Complete a steady airfoil external-flow analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/airfoil/`: - Replace the cylinder geometry with a NACA0012 airfoil - Set inflow conditions, angle of attack, and turbulence model - Run to convergence 2. Extract airfoil lift and drag coefficients. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Lift coefficient `cl` - Drag coefficient `cd` - Format: `cl, cd` 4. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
